{{Quote|I have done what I had to do in order to free my people. I have done this thing to make others understand they cannot own us.|An excerpt from the recording of the last words of Grunel Ovin|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction" />}}
'''Grunel Ovin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] freedom fighter who led the anti-[[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] organization known as the [[Sapience Defense Front]]. In [[44 ABY]], Ovin was arrested by forces of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and taken into custody onboard the [[CC-7700 frigate/Legends|CC-7700 frigate]] ''[[Fireborn]]''. Ovin was visited while in the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] brig by the [[Captain/Legends|captain]], a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] named [[Hunor]], who propositioned the Klatooinian with his own [[Death/Legends|death]] in exchange for martyrdom. The freedom fighter later recorded a barbed message to [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], and as it was broadcast across the expanse of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], Ovin was killed along with the entire crew of the ''Fireborn'' in the frigate's subsequent explosion over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Following his death, leadership of the Sapience Defense Front was assumed by Ovin's brother [[Padnel Ovin|Padnel]].
